messages:
jamie: Heads-up — dropping off a small mid-century stool (oak veneer) + a Philips Hue table lamp at the SF office Monday morning. Curbside pickup by reception. DM me if you want either. pic: https://imgur.com/placeholder

alex: Lamp pls if it's still there :raised_hands:

jamie: @alex done — can you swing by ~11am? I'll leave it labelled with your name.

priya: also have 2x festival tix (April 10) — can't make it, $30 each or trade for plants 😅 DM if interested.


drew: which festival?

priya: Noise & Bytes at The Fillmore, seats together. friend bailed.

solana-bot: Reminder: Office donation drop-off is this Friday at 4pm. Please label items with your name if you want a receipt. :package:

matt: anyone want a barely-used Magic Keyboard + trackpad (Mac layout)? Free if you pick up from Soma desk 2F.

alex: @jamie can you hold the lamp till 11:15? also @matt is the keyboard backlit?

matt: @alex yep mac layout and backlit. I'll leave it in the locker with sticky note 'matt - free keyboard'.

jamie: Perfect — stool will be by reception with sticky note 'jamie - free'.

priya: @drew i'll send pics of the tix in DM. they're e-tickets so i can transfer instantly.


drew: sweet, i'll take them if pics look good. thanks!

jamie: trade update: if someone grabs the stool i can leave the lamp at the bench if alex no-show. ping here if you want me to hold something. :slightly_smiling_face:
